tonight.headline: Gordon is in, the lineup is right — one move left: claim Coker
body: Bad news first, and it is small: Jalen Coker — dropped by mistake on Wednesday — is still unclaimed on Chem waivers until Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX, and Garrett Wilson drew three targets last week while rookie Omar Cooper Jr. took over the Jets' production. Neither touches Sunday's lineup.

The swap the last three briefs asked for is made: at 21:43Z Ollie Gordon II went into the flex and DK Metcalf to the bench, so the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 130.2 to Guillo-tinas' 89.5, 70%. Friday's final reports are in and no AVIATO starter is on any of them.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: No AVIATO player has played. Eight starters kick off Sunday 12:00 CDMX, Gordon at 15:25, the Commanders D/ST at 19:20. Friday's reports: Allen and Bass not listed (BuffaloBills.com 30 Oct); Jefferson and Hockenson not listed (Vikings.com 30 Oct); Warren and Metcalf not listed, Rico Dowdle questionable with a knee (Yahoo 30 Oct); Tuten not listed (Jaguars On SI 30 Oct); Wilson not listed (NewYorkJets.com 30 Oct); Gordon not listed (Patriots.com joint report 30 Oct).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Sunday inactive among the starters — none carries a designation, so there is no contingency. If Dowdle sits, Warren's share grows; that is upside, not a move.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claim clears Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX — he misses Week 8 either way
doFirst.title: Claim Jalen Coker back, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Carried from Wednesday. Still on Chem waivers at 22:05Z Friday, clearing Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX. If the claim is already in, leave it.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 28 Oct 15:13Z: ADD Commanders D/ST, DROP Jalen Coker. The card that morning said drop Fairbairn — a second kicker, on a Houston bye. AVIATO still carry two kickers.

case.label: The player
case.body: Thursday at Green Bay he played 86% of the snaps and ran 38 routes: 5 targets, 2 catches, 36 yards and a 26-yard touchdown (RotoWire snap report, 30 Oct). 9.6 points (archive, Week 8). Tetairoa McMillan is Carolina's lead receiver at 11 targets; Coker is the full-time No. 2, not a part-timer.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn cannot start while Bass kicks; Chem starts one kicker and streams it (STRATEGY §5). An exception to the churn rule, stated: the rule protects considered decisions, and this drop was not the plan.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Waivers clear Wed 4 Nov 07:00Z — 02:00 CDMX. He misses Week 8 either way. Chem priority resets weekly; AVIATO are 10th, and rival claims are invisible.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker scores less than Diggs over Weeks 9-10 (archive). Untested (EXPIRED) if the claim is not placed or a rival wins it.

doFirst.sources: League file activity · RotoWire snaps 30 Oct · archive Week 8

whatWentWrong.title: The defence add dropped Coker
whatWentWrong.lead: 28 Oct 15:13Z: Commanders D/ST in, Jalen Coker out. The card said Fairbairn. Coker scored 9.6 on Thursday for nobody and is still on waivers.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Second day running a drop processed on the wrong player: on Wednesday morning the Bass claim took the Broncos D/ST instead of Fairbairn; that afternoon the D/ST add took Coker. Fairbairn — on bye, a second kicker — survived both.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Coker claim above. Chem's priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting; the risk is a rival claiming him first.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Coker drop was deliberate — then skip the claim and say why, so the next run stops recommending it.

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is the projection lineup — Gordon went into the flex at 21:43Z.

worthALook.name: Hunter Henry
worthALook.lead: Carried: the tight end behind Hockenson if Week 9 goes wrong.

case.label: The player
case.body: No designation on Friday; if A.J. Brown (questionable, missed two practices) sits, the Patriots lean harder on Henry and Raridon (Patriots.com 30 Oct). Double-digit points three straight weeks.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Hockenson hurt Sunday, or Likely not cleared after the bye — then Henry is a free-agent add for Week 9 with Fairbairn the drop if Coker's claim fails.

worthALook.name: Makai Lemon
worthALook.lead: A vacancy role, now confirmed: DeVonta Smith and Wicks are OUT Sunday (NBCSP 30 Oct).

case.label: The player
case.body: 7 catches, 67 yards and a TD in Monday's loss at Dallas; expected to be a top target with Smith (hamstring) and Wicks (ankle) ruled out Friday (NBC Sports Philadelphia 30 Oct). Tanner McKee throws to him.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Every AVIATO receiver is inside the expert top 24, and Coker is the receiver move. A free agent — nothing is lost by waiting.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Lemon above 25% of targets Sunday and Smith's hamstring reported as multi-week — then a free-agent add with Fairbairn the drop.

doNotChase.name: Rico Dowdle
doNotChase.lead: Your own Warren's backup — and now questionable himself.

case.label: The case for
case.body: 9 carries and a team-high 6 targets in Week 7 (archive); grows only if Warren misses time.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Questionable with a knee, new on Friday (Yahoo 30 Oct). 9.4 projected, below all four AVIATO backs.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Warren hurt — then Dowdle is the handcuff, if his knee lets him play.

doNotChase.name: KC Concepcion
doNotChase.lead: A real role, and no slot for him here — Coker back is the better receiver move.

case.label: The case for
case.body: 10 targets, 129 yards and 23.2 in Week 7 (archive). No Week 8 designation found this run; Deshaun Watson at quarterback.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.2 projected at Pittsburgh — below every AVIATO receiver, and Coker (14.6) is the receiver to get back.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: An AVIATO receiver ruled out for multiple weeks and the Coker claim lost.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nothing on the wire beats this roster on usage. Every rostered receiver is inside this week's expert top 24, so none is movable; the RB and TE bars are not cleared. Seven weeks of data. The one receiver move is undoing Wednesday's drop — the Coker claim above.
